description: The ManageEngine ADAudit Plus login page is open in Microsoft Edge. Log in with username 'admin' and password 'Admin@2024'. Then navigate to the Settings or Admin area and configure the email notification settings (SMTP/Mail Server). Set the SMTP Server to 'smtp.company.local', Port to '587', select 'TLS' as the security type, set the From Address to 'adaudit-alerts@company.local', and the Admin Email to 'admin@company.local'. Save the configuration.
